title: The Overlooked Repetitive Lengthening Form in Sentiment Analysis
summary: Individuals engaging in online communication frequently express personal opinions with informal styles (e.g., memes and emojis). While Language Models (LMs) with informal communications have been widely discussed, a unique and emphatic style, the Repetitive Lengthening Form (RLF), has been overlooked for years. In this paper, we explore answers to two research questions: 1) Is RLF important for sentiment analysis (SA)? 2) Can LMs understand RLF? Inspired by previous linguistic research, we curate \textbf{Lengthening}, the first multi-domain dataset with 850k samples focused on RLF for SA. Moreover, we introduce \textbf{Exp}lainable \textbf{Instruct}ion Tuning (\textbf{ExpInstruct}), a two-stage instruction tuning framework aimed to improve both performance and explainability of LLMs for RLF. We further propose a novel unified approach to quantify LMs' understanding of informal expressions. We show that RLF sentences are expressive expressions and can serve as signatures of document-level sentiment. Additionally, RLF has potential value for online content analysis. Our results show that fine-tuned Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) can surpass zero-shot GPT-4 in performance but not in explanation for RLF. Finally, we show ExpInstruct can improve the open-sourced LLMs to match zero-shot GPT-4 in performance and explainability for RLF with limited samples. Code and sample data are available at https://github.com/Tom-Owl/OverlookedRLF

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在线沟通中常见的重复延长形式（RLF）对情感分析的重要性，创建了首个RLF多领域数据集Lengthening，并提出了可解释指令调优框架ExpInstruct来提升LLM对RLF的理解和解释能力。
AI.motivation: 在线交流中人们经常使用非正式表达方式（如表情包、表情符号），但一种独特的强调风格——重复延长形式（RLF）多年来一直被忽视。研究者希望探索RLF对情感分析的重要性，以及语言模型是否能理解这种表达方式。
AI.method: 1) 基于先前语言学研究，创建了首个专注于RLF的多领域数据集Lengthening（85万样本）；2) 提出了可解释指令调优框架ExpInstruct，这是一个两阶段的指令调优框架，旨在提升LLM对RLF的性能和可解释性；3) 提出了一种统一的方法来量化语言模型对非正式表达的理解能力。
AI.result: 研究发现：1) RLF句子是富有表现力的表达方式，可以作为文档级情感的特征标记；2) RLF对在线内容分析具有潜在价值；3) 微调的预训练语言模型在性能上可以超越零样本GPT-4，但在解释能力上不如GPT-4；4) ExpInstruct能够用有限样本提升开源LLM，使其在RLF任务上达到与零样本GPT-4相当的性能和可解释性。
AI.conclusion: RLF是情感分析中重要但被忽视的非正式表达形式，通过专门的数据集和指令调优框架，可以显著提升语言模型对这种表达方式的理解和解释能力，为在线内容分析提供了新的工具和方法。

title: Scaling Reasoning Tokens via RL and Parallel Thinking: Evidence From Competitive Programming
summary: We study how to scale reasoning token budgets for competitive programming through two complementary approaches: training-time reinforcement learning (RL) and test-time parallel thinking. During RL training, we observe an approximately log-linear relationship between validation accuracy and the average number of generated reasoning tokens over successive checkpoints, and show two ways to shift this training trajectory: verification RL warmup raises the starting point, while randomized clipping produces a steeper trend in the observed regime. As scaling single-generation reasoning during RL quickly becomes expensive under full attention, we introduce a multi-round parallel thinking pipeline that distributes the token budget across threads and rounds of generation, verification, and refinement. We train the model end-to-end on this pipeline to match the training objective to the test-time structure. Starting from Seed-OSS-36B, the full system with 16 threads and 16 rounds per thread matches the underlying RL model's oracle pass@16 at pass@1 using 7.6 million tokens per problem on average, and surpasses GPT-5-high on 456 hard competitive programming problems from AetherCode.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何通过训练时强化学习和测试时并行思考来扩展竞争性编程的推理令牌预算，提出了多轮并行思考管道，显著提升了推理效率。
AI.motivation: 竞争性编程需要大量推理令牌，但单次生成的推理在强化学习中成本高昂。需要探索更高效的扩展推理预算的方法，以提升模型在复杂编程问题上的表现。
AI.method: 采用两种互补方法：1) 训练时强化学习，包括验证RL预热和随机剪枝技术；2) 测试时多轮并行思考管道，将令牌预算分配到多个线程和轮次中，进行生成、验证和精炼。基于Seed-OSS-36B模型进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 系统使用16线程和每线程16轮，平均每个问题使用760万令牌，在pass@1指标上匹配了底层RL模型的oracle pass@16性能，并在AetherCode的456个困难竞争性编程问题上超越了GPT-5-high。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合训练时强化学习和测试时并行思考，可以有效扩展推理令牌预算，显著提升模型在复杂编程任务上的性能，为大规模推理系统提供了高效解决方案。

title: M2-Verify: A Large-Scale Multidomain Benchmark for Checking Multimodal Claim Consistency
summary: Evaluating scientific arguments requires assessing the strict consistency between a claim and its underlying multimodal evidence. However, existing benchmarks lack the scale, domain diversity, and visual complexity needed to evaluate this alignment realistically. To address this gap, we introduce M2-Verify, a large-scale multimodal dataset for checking scientific claim consistency. Sourced from PubMed and arXiv, M2-Verify provides over 469K instances across 16 domains, rigorously validated through expert audits. Extensive baseline experiments show that state-of-the-art models struggle to maintain robust consistency. While top models achieve up to 85.8\% Micro-F1 on low-complexity medical perturbations, performance drops to 61.6\% on high-complexity challenges like anatomical shifts. Furthermore, expert evaluations expose hallucinations when models generate scientific explanations for their alignment decisions. Finally, we demonstrate our dataset's utility and provide comprehensive usage guidelines.

AI.tldr: M2-Verify是一个大规模多模态数据集，用于评估科学主张与多模态证据之间的一致性，包含超过46.9万个实例，涵盖16个领域，模型在复杂场景下表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏足够的规模、领域多样性和视觉复杂性来真实评估科学主张与多模态证据之间的一致性，需要更全面的数据集来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从PubMed和arXiv收集数据，构建包含超过469K实例的M2-Verify数据集，涵盖16个领域，并通过专家审核进行严格验证，进行基线实验评估现有模型性能。
AI.result: 最先进模型在一致性检查上表现不佳：在低复杂度医学扰动上达到85.8% Micro-F1，但在高复杂度挑战（如解剖结构变化）上性能降至61.6%，专家评估还发现模型在生成科学解释时存在幻觉问题。
AI.conclusion: M2-Verify数据集填补了现有基准的不足，揭示了当前模型在科学主张一致性检查方面的局限性，特别是面对复杂视觉挑战时的性能下降和幻觉问题，为未来研究提供了有价值的资源和指导。

title: Preference learning in shades of gray: Interpretable and bias-aware reward modeling for human preferences
summary: Learning human preferences in language models remains fundamentally challenging, as reward modeling relies on subtle, subjective comparisons or shades of gray rather than clear-cut labels. This study investigates the limits of current approaches and proposes a feature-augmented framework to better capture the multidimensional nature of human judgment. Using the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset, we evaluate ten diverse large language models LLMs under a standard pairwise preference setting, where baseline performance remains below 0.74 ROC AUC, highlighting the difficulty of the task. To address this, we enrich textual representations with interpretable signals: response length, refusal indicators, toxicity scores and prompt response semantic similarity, enabling models to explicitly capture key aspects of helpfulness, safety and relevance. The proposed hybrid approach yields consistent improvements across all models, achieving up to 0.84 ROC AUC and significantly higher pairwise accuracy, with DeBERTav3Large demonstrating the best performance. Beyond accuracy, we integrate SHAP and LIME to provide fine-grained interpretability, revealing that model decisions depend on contextualized safety and supportive framing rather than isolated keywords. We further analyze bias amplification, showing that while individual features have weak marginal effects, their interactions influence preference learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种特征增强框架，通过整合可解释信号（如响应长度、拒绝指标、毒性分数等）来改进语言模型中人类偏好的学习，在Anthropic HHRLHF数据集上显著提升了ROC AUC和配对准确率。
AI.motivation: 语言模型中人类偏好的学习仍然具有根本性挑战，因为奖励建模依赖于微妙、主观的比较而非明确标签。当前方法在标准配对偏好设置下表现有限（ROC AUC低于0.74），需要更好地捕捉人类判断的多维性质。
AI.method: 提出混合方法：在文本表示基础上增强可解释信号，包括响应长度、拒绝指标、毒性分数和提示-响应语义相似度。使用Anthropic HHRLHF数据集评估10个不同的大型语言模型，并集成SHAP和LIME进行细粒度可解释性分析。
AI.result: 特征增强框架在所有模型上带来一致改进，ROC AUC最高达0.84，配对准确率显著提高。DeBERTav3Large表现最佳。可解释性分析显示模型决策依赖于情境化安全性和支持性框架而非孤立关键词。特征交互影响偏好学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合结构化特征增强文本表示能有效改进人类偏好学习，提供更准确的奖励建模。可解释性分析揭示了模型决策机制，特征交互在偏好学习中起重要作用，为未来偏好对齐研究提供了新方向。

title: ReFormeR: Learning and Applying Explicit Query Reformulation Patterns
summary: We present ReFormeR, a pattern-guided approach for query reformulation. Instead of prompting a language model to generate reformulations of a query directly, ReFormeR first elicits short reformulation patterns from pairs of initial queries and empirically stronger reformulations, consolidates them into a compact library of transferable reformulation patterns, and then selects an appropriate reformulation pattern for a new query given its retrieval context. The selected pattern constrains query reformulation to controlled operations such as sense disambiguation, vocabulary grounding, or discriminative facet addition, to name a few. As such, our proposed approach makes the reformulation policy explicit through these reformulation patterns, guiding the LLM towards targeted and effective query reformulations. Our extensive experiments on TREC DL 2019, DL 2020, and DL Hard show consistent improvements over classical feedback methods and recent LLM-based query reformulation and expansion approaches.

AI.tldr: ReFormeR：一种基于模式引导的查询重构方法，通过从查询对中提取重构模式，构建模式库，然后根据检索上下文为新查询选择合适模式，实现可控的查询重构操作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的查询重构方法通常直接生成重构查询，缺乏可控性和可解释性。需要一种更明确、可控制的重构策略，使语言模型能够进行有针对性和有效的查询重构。
AI.method: 1. 从初始查询和实证更强的重构查询对中提取简短的重构模式；2. 将模式整合成紧凑的可转移模式库；3. 根据新查询的检索上下文选择合适重构模式；4. 使用选定模式约束语言模型进行可控操作（如词义消歧、词汇接地、区分性方面添加等）。
AI.result: 在TREC DL 2019、DL 2020和DL Hard数据集上的广泛实验表明，ReFormeR相比经典反馈方法和近期基于语言模型的查询重构与扩展方法，取得了持续改进。
AI.conclusion: ReFormeR通过重构模式使重构策略明确化，引导语言模型进行有针对性和有效的查询重构，在多个基准测试中表现出优于现有方法的性能。

title: DOne: Decoupling Structure and Rendering for High-Fidelity Design-to-Code Generation
summary: While Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise in Design-to-Code generation, they suffer from a "holistic bottleneck-failing to reconcile high-level structural hierarchy with fine-grained visual details, often resulting in layout distortions or generic placeholders. To bridge this gap, we propose DOne, an end-to-end framework that decouples structure understanding from element rendering. DOne introduces (1) a learned layout segmentation module to decompose complex designs, avoiding the limitations of heuristic cropping; (2) a specialized hybrid element retriever to handle the extreme aspect ratios and densities of UI components; and (3) a schema-guided generation paradigm that bridges layout and code. To rigorously assess performance, we introduce HiFi2Code, a benchmark featuring significantly higher layout complexity than existing datasets. Extensive evaluations on the HiFi2Code demonstrate that DOne outperforms exiting methods in both high-level visual similarity (e.g., over 10% in GPT Score) and fine-grained element alignment. Human evaluations confirm a 3 times productivity gain with higher visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: DOne框架通过解耦结构理解和元素渲染来解决VLMs在Design-to-Code生成中的"整体瓶颈"问题，在复杂布局数据集上显著提升视觉相似度和元素对齐精度
AI.motivation: 当前Vision Language Models在Design-to-Code生成中存在"整体瓶颈"问题，无法同时兼顾高层次结构层次和细粒度视觉细节，导致布局失真或使用通用占位符
AI.method: 提出DOne端到端框架，包含：(1)学习型布局分割模块分解复杂设计，避免启发式裁剪限制；(2)专门化混合元素检索器处理UI组件的极端宽高比和密度；(3)模式引导的生成范式连接布局和代码
AI.result: 在HiFi2Code基准测试中，DOne在高层视觉相似度（如GPT Score提升超过10%）和细粒度元素对齐方面均优于现有方法；人工评估显示生产力提升3倍且视觉保真度更高
AI.conclusion: DOne通过解耦结构理解和元素渲染的方法有效解决了VLMs在Design-to-Code生成中的瓶颈问题，在复杂布局场景下实现了显著的性能提升和生产力增益

title: DySCo: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Effective Long-term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting (TSF) is critical across domains such as finance, meteorology, and energy. While extending the lookback window theoretically provides richer historical context, in practice, it often introduces irrelevant noise and computational redundancy, preventing models from effectively capturing complex long-term dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Compression (DySCo) framework. Unlike traditional methods that rely on fixed heuristics, DySCo introduces an Entropy-Guided Dynamic Sampling (EGDS) mechanism to autonomously identify and retain high-entropy segments while compressing redundant trends. Furthermore, we incorporate a Hierarchical Frequency-Enhanced Decomposition (HFED) strategy to separate high-frequency anomalies from low-frequency patterns, ensuring that critical details are preserved during sparse sampling. Finally, a Cross-Scale Interaction Mixer(CSIM) is designed to dynamically fuse global contexts with local representations, replacing simple linear aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate that DySCo serves as a universal plug-and-play module, significantly enhancing the ability of mainstream models to capture long-term correlations with reduced computational cost.

AI.tldr: DySCo是一个动态语义压缩框架，通过熵引导动态采样、分层频率增强分解和跨尺度交互混合器，有效提升时间序列预测模型的长时依赖捕捉能力，同时降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测中，延长回溯窗口理论上能提供更丰富的历史上下文，但实践中常引入无关噪声和计算冗余，阻碍模型有效捕捉复杂的长时依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出动态语义压缩框架DySCo：1) 熵引导动态采样机制自主识别并保留高熵片段，压缩冗余趋势；2) 分层频率增强分解策略分离高频异常和低频模式；3) 跨尺度交互混合器动态融合全局上下文与局部表征。
AI.result: 实验表明DySCo可作为通用即插即用模块，显著增强主流模型捕捉长时相关性的能力，同时降低计算成本。
AI.conclusion: DySCo框架通过动态语义压缩有效解决了时间序列预测中长时依赖捕捉的挑战，在保持关键细节的同时减少计算冗余，具有广泛的适用性。

title: Procedural Knowledge at Scale Improves Reasoning
summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as an effective way to improve language models on challenging reasoning tasks. However, most existing methods treat each problem in isolation and do not systematically reuse knowledge from prior reasoning trajectories. In particular, they underutilize procedural knowledge: how to reframe a problem, choose an approach, and verify or backtrack when needed. We introduce Reasoning Memory, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for reasoning models that explicitly retrieves and reuses procedural knowledge at scale. Starting from existing corpora of step-by-step reasoning trajectories, we decompose each trajectory into self-contained subquestion-subroutine pairs, yielding a datastore of 32 million compact procedural knowledge entries. At inference time, a lightweight in-thought prompt lets the model verbalize the core subquestion, retrieve relevant subroutines within its reasoning trace, and reason under diverse retrieved subroutines as implicit procedural priors. Across six math, science, and coding benchmarks, Reasoning Memory consistently outperforms RAG with document, trajectory, and template knowledge, as well as a compute-matched test-time scaling baseline. With a higher inference budget, it improves over no retrieval by up to 19.2% and over the strongest compute-matched baseline by 7.9% across task types. Ablation studies show that these gains come from two key factors: the broad procedural coverage of the source trajectories and our decomposition and retrieval design, which together enable effective extraction and reuse of procedural knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出Reasoning Memory框架，通过检索和重用程序性知识来增强推理模型，在数学、科学和编程任务上显著优于现有方法
AI.motivation: 现有测试时缩放方法将每个问题孤立处理，未能系统性地重用先前推理轨迹中的程序性知识（如问题重构、方法选择、验证和回溯等）
AI.method: 从逐步推理轨迹语料库中分解出3200万个自包含的子问题-子程序对，构建程序性知识库；推理时通过轻量级提示让模型表达核心子问题，检索相关子程序作为隐式程序先验
AI.result: 在六个数学、科学和编程基准测试中，Reasoning Memory始终优于基于文档、轨迹和模板知识的RAG方法，以及计算匹配的测试时缩放基线；在高推理预算下，相比无检索提升达19.2%，相比最强基线提升7.9%
AI.conclusion: Reasoning Memory通过广泛的程序性知识覆盖以及分解和检索设计，有效提取和重用程序性知识，显著提升语言模型在复杂推理任务上的表现

title: STABLE: Efficient Hybrid Nearest Neighbor Search via Magnitude-Uniformity and Cardinality-Robustness
summary: Hybrid Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (Hybrid ANNS) is a foundational search technology for large-scale heterogeneous data and has gained significant attention in both academia and industry. However, current approaches overlook the heterogeneity in data distribution, thus ignoring two major challenges: the Compatibility Barrier for Similarity Magnitude Heterogeneity and the Tolerance Bottleneck to Attribute Cardinality. To overcome these issues, we propose the robuSt heTerogeneity-Aware hyBrid retrievaL framEwork, STABLE, designed for accurate, efficient, and robust hybrid ANNS under datasets with various distributions. Specifically, we introduce an enhAnced heterogeneoUs semanTic perceptiOn (AUTO) metric to achieve a joint measurement of feature similarity and attribute consistency, addressing similarity magnitude heterogeneity and improving robustness to datasets with various attribute cardinalities. Thereafter, we construct our Heterogeneous sEmantic reLation graPh (HELP) index based on AUTO to organize heterogeneous semantic relations. Finally, we employ a novel Dynamic Heterogeneity Routing method to ensure an efficient search. Extensive experiments on five feature vector benchmarks with various attribute cardinalities demonstrate the superior performance of STABLE.

AI.tldr: STABLE框架通过AUTO度量、HELP索引和动态异构路由解决混合近似最近邻搜索中的数据分布异质性挑战
AI.motivation: 当前混合近似最近邻搜索方法忽视数据分布的异质性，存在相似性幅度异质性的兼容性障碍和属性基数容忍度瓶颈两大挑战
AI.method: 提出STABLE框架：1) AUTO度量联合测量特征相似性和属性一致性；2) HELP索引组织异构语义关系；3) 动态异构路由方法确保高效搜索
AI.result: 在五个具有不同属性基数的特征向量基准测试中，STABLE表现出优越性能
AI.conclusion: STABLE框架能够为具有各种分布的数据集提供准确、高效且鲁棒的混合近似最近邻搜索

title: From BM25 to Corrective RAG: Benchmarking Retrieval Strategies for Text-and-Table Documents
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems critically depend on retrieval quality, yet no systematic comparison of modern retrieval methods exists for heterogeneous documents containing both text and tabular data. We benchmark ten retrieval strategies spanning sparse, dense, hybrid fusion, cross-encoder reranking, query expansion, index augmentation, and adaptive retrieval on a challenging financial QA benchmark of 23,088 queries over 7,318 documents with mixed text-and-table content. We evaluate retrieval quality via Recall@k, MRR, and nDCG, and end-to-end generation quality via Number Match, with paired bootstrap significance testing. Our results show that (1) a two-stage pipeline combining hybrid retrieval with neural reranking achieves Recall@5 of 0.816 and MRR@3 of 0.605, outperforming all single-stage methods by a large margin; (2) BM25 outperforms state-of-the-art dense retrieval on financial documents, challenging the common assumption that semantic search universally dominates; and (3) query expansion methods (HyDE, multi-query) and adaptive retrieval provide limited benefit for precise numerical queries, while contextual retrieval yields consistent gains. We provide ablation studies on fusion methods and reranker depth, actionable cost-accuracy recommendations, and release our full benchmark code.

AI.tldr: 对包含文本和表格数据的异构文档，系统比较了十种检索策略在金融QA基准上的表现，发现两阶段混合检索+神经重排序效果最佳，BM25优于密集检索，查询扩展对数值查询帮助有限。
AI.motivation: RAG系统严重依赖检索质量，但目前缺乏对包含文本和表格数据的异构文档的现代检索方法进行系统比较。特别是在金融领域，文档通常包含混合的文本和表格内容，需要评估不同检索策略在这种复杂场景下的表现。
AI.method: 在包含23,088个查询和7,318个混合文本表格文档的金融QA基准上，对十种检索策略进行基准测试：稀疏检索（BM25）、密集检索、混合融合、交叉编码器重排序、查询扩展（HyDE、多查询）、索引增强和自适应检索。使用Recall@k、MRR、nDCG评估检索质量，使用Number Match评估端到端生成质量，并进行配对自助显著性检验。
AI.result: 1. 两阶段管道（混合检索+神经重排序）表现最佳：Recall@5达到0.816，MRR@3达到0.605，显著优于所有单阶段方法。2. BM25在金融文档上优于最先进的密集检索，挑战了语义搜索普遍占优的假设。3. 查询扩展方法（HyDE、多查询）和自适应检索对精确数值查询帮助有限，而上下文检索则带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: 对于包含文本和表格的异构金融文档，两阶段混合检索+神经重排序是最有效的检索策略。BM25等传统方法在特定领域仍具竞争力，而查询扩展对数值查询效果有限。研究提供了融合方法和重排序深度的消融研究、成本-准确性建议，并发布了完整的基准代码。

title: Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions with Foresight Learning
summary:
Anticipating supply chain disruptions before they materialize is a core challenge for firms and policymakers alike. A key difficulty is learning to reason reliably about infrequent, high-impact events from noisy and unstructured inputs - a setting where general-purpose models struggle without task-specific adaptation. We introduce an end-to-end framework that trains LLMs to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts using realized disruption outcomes as supervision. The resulting model substantially outperforms strong baselines - including GPT-5 - on accuracy, calibration, and precision. We also show that training induces more structured and reliable probabilistic reasoning without explicit prompting. These results suggest a general pathway for training domain-specific forecasting models that produce decision-ready signals. To support transparency we open-source the evaluation dataset used in this study.
  Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LightningRodLabs/supply-chain-predictions

AI.tldr: 提出端到端框架训练LLM生成校准的概率预测，用于供应链中断预测，显著优于GPT-5等基线
AI.motivation: 预测供应链中断是企业和政策制定者的核心挑战，但通用模型难以从噪声和非结构化输入中可靠地推理低频高影响事件
AI.method: 引入端到端框架，使用实际中断结果作为监督训练LLM生成校准的概率预测，无需显式提示即可诱导结构化概率推理
AI.result: 模型在准确性、校准性和精确度上显著优于包括GPT-5在内的强基线，训练可诱导更结构化可靠的概率推理
AI.conclusion: 为训练领域特定预测模型提供通用路径，可生成决策就绪信号，开源评估数据集支持透明度

title: Do We Need Bigger Models for Science? Task-Aware Retrieval with Small Language Models
summary: Scientific knowledge discovery increasingly relies on large language models, yet many existing scholarly assistants depend on proprietary systems with tens or hundreds of billions of parameters. Such reliance limits reproducibility and accessibility for the research community. In this work, we ask a simple question: do we need bigger models for scientific applications? Specifically, we investigate to what extent carefully designed retrieval pipelines can compensate for reduced model scale in scientific applications. We design a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework that performs task-aware routing to select specialized retrieval strategies based on the input query. The system further integrates evidence from full-text scientific papers and structured scholarly metadata, and employs compact instruction-tuned language models to generate responses with citations. We evaluate the framework across several scholarly tasks, focusing on scholarly question answering (QA), including single- and multi-document scenarios, as well as biomedical QA under domain shift and scientific text compression. Our findings demonstrate that retrieval and model scale are complementary rather than interchangeable. While retrieval design can partially compensate for smaller models, model capacity remains important for complex reasoning tasks. This work highlights retrieval and task-aware design as key factors for building practical and reproducible scholarly assistants.

AI.tldr: 检索增强框架结合任务感知路由和紧凑语言模型，在科学应用中部分补偿模型规模，但复杂推理仍需模型能力
AI.motivation: 当前科学知识发现过度依赖大型专有模型，限制了研究的可复现性和可访问性，需要探索检索设计能否补偿模型规模
AI.method: 设计轻量级检索增强框架，包含任务感知路由选择专用检索策略，整合全文科学论文和结构化元数据，使用紧凑指令调优语言模型生成带引用的回答
AI.result: 检索和模型规模是互补而非可互换的，检索设计可部分补偿小模型，但复杂推理任务仍需模型容量
AI.conclusion: 检索和任务感知设计是构建实用且可复现学术助手的关键因素

title: Look Twice: Training-Free Evidence Highlighting in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Answering questions about images often requires combining visual understanding with external knowledge. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural framework for this setting, but they often struggle to identify the most relevant visual and textual evidence when answering knowledge-intensive queries. In such scenarios, models must integrate visual cues with retrieved textual evidence that is often noisy or only partially relevant, while also localizing fine-grained visual information in the image. In this work, we introduce Look Twice (LoT), a training-free inference-time framework that improves how pretrained MLLMs utilize multimodal evidence. Specifically, we exploit the model attention patterns to estimate which visual regions and retrieved textual elements are relevant to a query, and then generate the answer conditioned on this highlighted evidence. The selected cues are highlighted through lightweight prompt-level markers that encourage the model to re-attend to the relevant evidence during generation. Experiments across multiple knowledge-based VQA benchmarks show consistent improvements over zero-shot MLLMs. Additional evaluations on vision-centric and hallucination-oriented benchmarks further demonstrate that visual evidence highlighting alone improves model performance in settings without textual context, all without additional training or architectural modifications. Source code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: Look Twice (LoT)是一个无需训练、推理时优化的框架，通过注意力模式识别相关视觉区域和文本证据，使用提示标记重新关注关键信息，提升多模态大语言模型在知识密集型视觉问答中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在回答需要结合视觉理解和外部知识的查询时，往往难以识别最相关的视觉和文本证据。模型需要整合视觉线索与检索到的文本证据（这些证据通常嘈杂或仅部分相关），同时定位图像中的细粒度视觉信息。
AI.method: 提出Look Twice (LoT)框架，利用模型注意力模式估计与查询相关的视觉区域和检索到的文本元素，然后基于这些高亮证据生成答案。通过轻量级的提示级标记来突出显示选定的线索，鼓励模型在生成过程中重新关注相关证据。
AI.result: 在多个基于知识的VQA基准测试中，相比零样本MLLMs取得了持续改进。在无文本上下文的纯视觉中心和幻觉导向基准测试上的额外评估进一步表明，仅视觉证据高亮就能提升模型性能，且无需额外训练或架构修改。
AI.conclusion: LoT是一个有效的推理时优化框架，通过注意力引导的证据高亮机制，显著提升了预训练多模态大语言模型在整合多模态证据方面的能力，特别是在知识密集型视觉问答任务中。

title: Friends and Grandmothers in Silico: Localizing Entity Cells in Language Models
summary: Language models can answer many entity-centric factual questions, but it remains unclear which internal mechanisms are involved in this process. We study this question across multiple language models. We localize entity-selective MLP neurons using templated prompts about each entity, and then validate them with causal interventions on PopQA-based QA examples. On a curated set of 200 entities drawn from PopQA, localized neurons concentrate in early layers. Negative ablation produces entity-specific amnesia, while controlled injection at a placeholder token improves answer retrieval relative to mean-entity and wrong-cell controls. For many entities, activating a single localized neuron is sufficient to recover entity-consistent predictions once the context is initialized, consistent with compact entity retrieval rather than purely gradual enrichment across depth. Robustness to aliases, acronyms, misspellings, and multilingual forms supports a canonicalization interpretation. The effect is strong but not universal: not every entity admits a reliable single-neuron handle, and coverage is higher for popular entities. Overall, these results identify sparse, causally actionable access points for analyzing and modulating entity-conditioned factual behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过定位语言模型中实体选择性的MLP神经元，揭示了实体事实检索的内部机制，发现早期层存在稀疏的、因果可操作的实体检索点。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能够回答许多以实体为中心的事实性问题，但其内部机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探索语言模型在实体事实检索过程中涉及的内部机制。
AI.method: 使用模板化提示定位多个语言模型中对特定实体具有选择性的MLP神经元，然后在PopQA基准的QA示例上进行因果干预验证。研究选取了PopQA中的200个实体进行系统分析。
AI.result: 定位的神经元主要集中在早期层；负向消融导致实体特异性遗忘，而在占位符处注入控制信号能改善答案检索；对许多实体，激活单个神经元就足以恢复实体一致的预测；机制对别名、缩写、拼写错误和多语言形式具有鲁棒性；效果显著但不普遍，覆盖率对流行实体更高。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别了稀疏的、因果可操作的访问点，可用于分析和调节实体条件化的事实行为，支持紧凑实体检索而非纯粹深度渐进富集的解释。

title: Multi-Agent Video Recommenders: Evolution, Patterns, and Open Challenges
comment: Accepted for publication in The Nineteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM Companion 2026)
summary: Video recommender systems are among the most popular and impactful applications of AI, shaping content consumption and influencing culture for billions of users. Traditional single-model recommenders, which optimize static engagement metrics, are increasingly limited in addressing the dynamic requirements of modern platforms. In response, multi-agent architectures are redefining how video recommender systems serve, learn, and adapt to both users and datasets. These agent-based systems coordinate specialized agents responsible for video understanding, reasoning, memory, and feedback, to provide precise, explainable recommendations. In this survey, we trace the evolution of multi-agent video recommendation systems (MAVRS). We combine ideas from multi-agent recommender systems, foundation models, and conversational AI, culminating in the emerging field of large language model (LLM)-powered MAVRS. We present a taxonomy of collaborative patterns and analyze coordination mechanisms across diverse video domains, ranging from short-form clips to educational platforms. We discuss representative frameworks, including early multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) systems such as MMRF and recent LLM-driven architectures like MACRec and Agent4Rec, to illustrate these patterns. We also outline open challenges in scalability, multimodal understanding, incentive alignment, and identify research directions such as hybrid reinforcement learning-LLM systems, lifelong personalization and self-improving recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了多智能体视频推荐系统(MAVRS)的发展历程，从传统的单模型推荐系统到基于多智能体架构的系统，再到新兴的LLM驱动的MAVRS，分析了协作模式分类、协调机制，并讨论了代表性框架和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 传统单模型视频推荐系统仅优化静态参与度指标，难以满足现代平台的动态需求。多智能体架构通过协调专门负责视频理解、推理、记忆和反馈的智能体，能够提供更精确、可解释的推荐，从而重新定义视频推荐系统的服务、学习和适应方式。
AI.method: 论文采用综述研究方法，追溯多智能体视频推荐系统的演进历程。结合多智能体推荐系统、基础模型和对话AI的思想，提出LLM驱动的MAVRS新兴领域。建立了协作模式分类法，分析了跨不同视频领域（从短视频到教育平台）的协调机制。通过分析代表性框架（如早期MARL系统MMRF和近期LLM驱动架构MACRec、Agent4Rec）来阐释这些模式。
AI.result: 论文系统梳理了MAVRS的发展脉络，提出了多智能体视频推荐系统的分类体系，识别了不同协作模式和协调机制。通过分析具体框架展示了多智能体架构如何提升推荐系统的精确性和可解释性，同时指出了从传统MARL到LLM驱动的技术演进趋势。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体视频推荐系统代表了视频推荐技术的重要发展方向，能够更好地满足现代平台的动态需求。LLM驱动的MAVRS结合了多智能体推荐系统、基础模型和对话AI的优势，展现出巨大潜力。未来研究应关注可扩展性、多模态理解、激励对齐等挑战，并探索混合强化学习-LLM系统、终身个性化和自改进推荐系统等方向。

title: Sparse Spectral LoRA: Routed Experts for Medical VLMs
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) excel on general benchmarks but often lack robustness in medical imaging, where heterogeneous supervision induces cross-dataset interference and sensitivity to data regime (i.e., how the supervisory signals are mixed). In realistic clinical workflows, data and tasks arrive sequentially, so naive continual training further leads to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose MedQwen, a parameter-efficient medical VLM that couples a spectrally routed Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with a theoretically grounded scaling rule that aligns low-rank updates with a full-rank, fully fine-tuned MoE, without changing the base architecture. Concretely, we initialize each expert from non-overlapping singular value decomposition (SVD) segments of the pretrained weight and introduce a residual compensation and scaling scheme to enable stable expert specialization and consistent routing under distribution shift. Across 23 medical datasets covering visual question answering, report generation, radiology classification, and hallucination mitigation, MedQwen achieves strong, reliable performance: it approaches full fine-tuning on zero-shot classification with 339$\times$ fewer trainable parameters, and reduces sequential forgetting to $\sim$5\% where strong baselines degrade by $>$20-50\%.

AI.tldr: MedQwen：一种参数高效的医学视觉语言模型，通过谱路由混合专家（MoE）架构和理论驱动的缩放规则，在保持基础架构不变的情况下，实现接近全参数微调的性能，同时大幅减少可训练参数并缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型在医学影像领域缺乏鲁棒性，存在跨数据集干扰和数据体制敏感性问题。在临床工作流中，数据和任务按顺序到达，传统的持续训练会导致灾难性遗忘。需要开发参数高效且能适应医学领域特殊需求的模型。
AI.method: 提出MedQwen模型，结合谱路由混合专家（MoE）架构：1）从预训练权重的非重叠奇异值分解（SVD）片段初始化每个专家；2）引入残差补偿和缩放方案，确保在分布偏移下稳定的专家专业化和一致路由；3）采用理论驱动的缩放规则，使低秩更新与全秩全参数微调的MoE对齐。
AI.result: 在23个医学数据集（涵盖视觉问答、报告生成、放射学分类和幻觉缓解）上表现优异：1）零样本分类任务中，仅用全参数微调1/339的可训练参数即达到相近性能；2）将顺序遗忘降至约5%，而基线模型性能下降20-50%。
AI.conclusion: MedQwen通过谱路由MoE架构和理论驱动的缩放规则，成功解决了医学视觉语言模型中的跨数据集干扰、数据体制敏感性和灾难性遗忘问题，实现了参数高效且鲁棒的持续学习能力。

title: An Online Machine Learning Multi-resolution Optimization Framework for Energy System Design Limit of Performance Analysis
summary: Designing reliable integrated energy systems for industrial processes requires optimization and verification models across multiple fidelities, from architecture-level sizing to high-fidelity dynamic operation. However, model mismatch across fidelities obscures the sources of performance loss and complicates the quantification of architecture-to-operation performance gaps. We propose an online, machine-learning-accelerated multi-resolution optimization framework that estimates an architecture-specific upper bound on achievable performance while minimizing expensive high-fidelity model evaluations. We demonstrate the approach on a pilot energy system supplying a 1 MW industrial heat load. First, we solve a multi-objective architecture optimization to select the system configuration and component capacities. We then develop an machine learning (ML)-accelerated multi-resolution, receding-horizon optimal control strategy that approaches the achievable-performance bound for the specified architecture, given the additional controls and dynamics not captured by the architectural optimization model. The ML-guided controller adaptively schedules the optimization resolution based on predictive uncertainty and warm-starts high-fidelity solves using elite low-fidelity solutions. Our results on the pilot case study show that the proposed multi-resolution strategy reduces the architecture-to-operation performance gap by up to 42% relative to a rule-based controller, while reducing required high-fidelity model evaluations by 34% relative to the same multi-fidelity approach without ML guidance, enabling faster and more reliable design verification. Together, these gains make high-fidelity verification tractable, providing a practical upper bound on achievable operational performance.

AI.tldr: 提出在线机器学习加速的多分辨率优化框架，通过估计架构特定性能上限并最小化高保真模型评估，减少工业能源系统的架构-运行性能差距
AI.motivation: 工业过程可靠集成能源系统设计需要在多个保真度级别进行优化和验证，但不同保真度模型之间的不匹配会掩盖性能损失来源，并使架构到运行性能差距的量化变得复杂
AI.method: 提出在线机器学习加速的多分辨率优化框架：1）多目标架构优化选择系统配置和组件容量；2）ML加速的多分辨率滚动时域最优控制策略，基于预测不确定性自适应调度优化分辨率，使用精英低保真解热启动高保真求解
AI.result: 在1 MW工业热负荷试点案例中，多分辨率策略相对于基于规则的控制器将架构-运行性能差距减少42%，相对于无ML指导的多保真方法减少34%的高保真模型评估需求
AI.conclusion: 该框架使高保真验证变得可行，提供了实际可达到操作性能的上限，实现了更快更可靠的设计验证

title: Assessing Pause Thresholds for empirical Translation Process Research
comment: Accepted for Presentation at "Translation in Transition 8, September 2026"
summary: Text production (and translations) proceeds in the form of stretches of typing, interrupted by keystroke pauses. It is often assumed that fast typing reflects unchallenged/automated translation production while long(er) typing pauses are indicative of translation problems, hurdles or difficulties. Building on a long discussion concerning the determination of pause thresholds that separate automated from presumably reflective translation processes (O'Brien, 2006; Alves and Vale, 2009; Timarova et al., 2011; Dragsted and Carl, 2013; Lacruz et al., 2014; Kumpulainen, 2015; Heilmann and Neumann 2016), this paper compares three recent approaches for computing these pause thresholds, and suggest and evaluate a novel method for computing Production Unit Breaks.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种计算翻译过程中停顿阈值的方法，并提出并评估了一种计算生产单元中断的新方法
AI.motivation: 翻译过程中的打字停顿通常被用来区分自动化翻译过程与需要认知努力的翻译过程。然而，如何确定区分这两种过程的停顿阈值一直存在争议，需要更可靠的方法来识别翻译中的生产单元中断。
AI.method: 比较了三种现有的停顿阈值计算方法，并提出了一种新的生产单元中断计算方法，并对这些方法进行了评估。
AI.result: 通过比较分析，展示了不同方法在确定翻译停顿阈值方面的差异，并验证了新提出的生产单元中断计算方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 确定翻译过程中的停顿阈值对于区分自动化与认知性翻译过程至关重要，新提出的生产单元中断计算方法为这一领域提供了更可靠的工具，有助于更准确地分析翻译认知过程。

title: Diagnosing Translated Benchmarks: An Automated Quality Assurance Study of the EU20 Benchmark Suite
summary: Machine-translated benchmark datasets reduce costs and offer scale, but noise, loss of structure, and uneven quality weaken confidence. What matters is not merely whether we can translate, but also whether we can measure and verify translation reliability at scale. We study translation quality in the EU20 benchmark suite, which comprises five established benchmarks translated into 20 languages, via a three-step automated quality assurance approach: (i) a structural corpus audit with targeted fixes; (ii) quality profiling using a neural metric (COMET, reference-free and reference-based) with translation service comparisons (DeepL / ChatGPT / Google); and (iii) an LLM-based span-level translation error landscape. Trends are consistent: datasets with lower COMET scores exhibit a higher share of accuracy/mistranslation errors at span level (notably HellaSwag; ARC is comparatively clean). Reference-based COMET on MMLU against human-edited samples points in the same direction. We release cleaned/corrected versions of the EU20 datasets, and code for reproducibility. In sum, automated quality assurance offers practical, scalable indicators that help prioritize review -- complementing, not replacing, human gold standards.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自动化质量保证方法评估机器翻译基准数据集质量，发现COMET分数与翻译错误率相关，并发布了清理后的EU20数据集
AI.motivation: 机器翻译的基准数据集虽然降低成本并提供规模，但存在噪声、结构丢失和质量不均等问题，需要可扩展的翻译可靠性测量和验证方法
AI.method: 采用三步自动化质量保证方法：1) 结构性语料库审计与针对性修复；2) 使用神经度量COMET（无参考和基于参考）进行质量分析，并与DeepL/ChatGPT/Google翻译服务比较；3) 基于LLM的片段级翻译错误分析
AI.result: 趋势一致：COMET分数较低的数据集在片段级别显示出更高的准确性/误译错误比例（特别是HellaSwag；ARC相对干净）。基于参考的COMET在MMLU上与人编辑样本的对比指向相同方向
AI.conclusion: 自动化质量保证提供了实用、可扩展的指标，有助于优先审查工作——补充而非替代人工黄金标准，并发布了清理/校正后的EU20数据集和可复现代码

title: ViTs for Action Classification in Videos: An Approach to Risky Tackle Detection in American Football Practice Videos
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ICPR 2026 (28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition)
summary: Early identification of hazardous actions in contact sports enables timely intervention and improves player safety. We present a method for detecting risky tackles in American football practice videos and introduce a substantially expanded dataset for this task. Our work contains 733 single-athlete-dummy tackle clips, each temporally localized around first point contact and labeled with a strike zone component of the standardized Assessment for Tackling Technique (SATT-3), extending prior work that reported 178 annotated videos. Using a Vision transformer-based model with imbalance-aware training, we obtain risky recall of 0.67 and Risky F1 of 0.59 under crossvalidation. Relative to the previous baseline in a smaller subset (risky recall of 0.58; Risky F1 0.56 ), our approach improves risky recall by more than 8% points on a much larger dataset. These results indicate that the vision transformer-based video analysis, coupled with careful handling of class imbalance, can reliably detect rare but safety-critical tackling patterns, offering a practical pathway toward coach-centered injury prevention tools.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于视觉Transformer的模型，用于从美式足球训练视频中检测危险擒抱动作，并扩展了相关数据集，通过不平衡感知训练显著提高了危险动作的召回率。
AI.motivation: 在接触性运动中及早识别危险动作能够及时干预并提高运动员安全性。美式足球中的擒抱技术评估对于预防伤害至关重要，但现有数据集有限且检测方法有待改进。
AI.method: 研究扩展了数据集至733个单运动员-假人擒抱视频片段，每个片段围绕首次接触点进行时间定位，并使用标准化擒抱技术评估(SATT-3)的击打区域组件进行标注。采用基于视觉Transformer的模型，结合不平衡感知训练来处理类别不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在交叉验证下获得危险召回率0.67和危险F1分数0.59。相较于先前在较小数据集上的基线(危险召回率0.58；危险F1分数0.56)，危险召回率提高了超过8个百分点，且是在更大数据集上实现的。
AI.conclusion: 视觉Transformer视频分析结合仔细的类别不平衡处理能够可靠地检测罕见但安全关键的擒抱模式，为教练中心的伤害预防工具提供了实用途径。

title: Optimizing RAG Rerankers with LLM Feedback via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Rerankers play a pivotal role in refining retrieval results for Retrieval-Augmented Generation. However, current reranking models are typically optimized on static human annotated relevance labels in isolation, decoupled from the downstream generation process. This isolation leads to a fundamental misalignment: documents identified as topically relevant by information retrieval metrics often fail to provide the actual utility required by the LLM for precise answer generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReRanking Preference Optimization (RRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that directly aligns reranking with the LLM's generation quality. By formulating reranking as a sequential decision-making process, RRPO optimizes for context utility using LLM feedback, thereby eliminating the need for expensive human annotations. To ensure training stability, we further introduce a reference-anchored deterministic baseline. Extensive experiments on knowledge-intensive benchmarks demonstrate that RRPO significantly outperforms strong baselines, including the powerful list-wise reranker RankZephyr. Further analysis highlights the versatility of our framework: it generalizes seamlessly to diverse readers (e.g., GPT-4o), integrates orthogonally with query expansion modules like Query2Doc, and remains robust even when trained with noisy supervisors.

AI.tldr: RRPO：基于强化学习的重排序偏好优化框架，通过LLM反馈直接对齐重排序与生成质量，无需人工标注
AI.motivation: 当前重排序模型基于静态人工标注的相关性标签进行优化，与下游生成过程解耦，导致检索到的文档虽然符合信息检索指标但无法为LLM提供实际生成答案所需的效用
AI.method: 提出ReRanking Preference Optimization (RRPO)强化学习框架，将重排序建模为序列决策过程，利用LLM反馈优化上下文效用；引入参考锚定的确定性基线确保训练稳定性
AI.result: 在知识密集型基准测试中，RRPO显著优于包括强大的列表式重排序器RankZephyr在内的基线模型；框架具有良好泛化性、正交集成能力和噪声鲁棒性
AI.conclusion: RRPO通过直接对齐重排序与LLM生成质量，有效解决了传统重排序模型与下游生成任务之间的错位问题，为检索增强生成提供了更有效的重排序解决方案

title: Human Pose Estimation in Trampoline Gymnastics: Improving Performance Using a New Synthetic Dataset
summary: Trampoline gymnastics involves extreme human poses and uncommon viewpoints, on which state-of-the art pose estimation models tend to under-perform. We demonstrate that this problem can be addressed by fine-tuning a pose estimation model on a dataset of synthetic trampoline poses (STP). STP is generated from motion capture recordings of trampoline routines. We develop a pipeline to fit noisy motion capture data to a parametric human model, then generate multiview realistic images. We use this data to fine-tune a ViTPose model, and test it on real multi-view trampoline images. The resulting model exhibits accuracy improvements in 2D which translates to improved 3D triangulation. In 2D, we obtain state-of-the-art results on such challenging data, bridging the performance gap between common and extreme poses. In 3D, we reduce the MPJPE by 12.5 mm with our best model, which represents an improvement of 19.6% compared to the pretrained ViTPose model.

AI.tldr: 通过合成数据微调ViTPose模型，显著提升蹦床体操极端姿态的2D/3D姿态估计精度
AI.motivation: 现有姿态估计模型在蹦床体操这类包含极端人体姿态和非常规视角的场景中表现不佳，需要专门优化
AI.method: 开发合成蹦床姿态数据集(STP)：从动作捕捉数据拟合参数化人体模型，生成多视角逼真图像；用此数据微调ViTPose模型
AI.result: 2D姿态估计达到SOTA，弥合了常规姿态与极端姿态的性能差距；3D三角化中MPJPE降低12.5mm，相比预训练模型提升19.6%
AI.conclusion: 合成数据微调能有效解决特定领域（如蹦床体操）的姿态估计问题，显著提升模型在极端姿态和非常规视角下的性能

title: Detecting Complex Money Laundering Patterns with Incremental and Distributed Graph Modeling
summary: Money launderers take advantage of limitations in existing detection approaches by hiding their financial footprints in a deceitful manner. They manage this by replicating transaction patterns that the monitoring systems cannot easily distinguish. As a result, criminally gained assets are pushed into legitimate financial channels without drawing attention. Algorithms developed to monitor money flows often struggle with scale and complexity. The difficulty of identifying such activities is further intensified by the (persistent) inability of current solutions to control the excessive number of false positive signals produced by rigid, risk-based rules systems. We propose a framework called ReDiRect (REduce, DIstribute, and RECTify), specifically designed to overcome these challenges. The primary contribution of our work is a novel framing of this problem in an unsupervised setting; where a large transaction graph is fuzzily partitioned into smaller, manageable components to enable fast processing in a distributed manner. In addition, we define a refined evaluation metric that better captures the effectiveness of exposed money laundering patterns. Through comprehensive experimentation, we demonstrate that our framework achieves superior performance compared to existing and state-of-the-art techniques, particularly in terms of efficiency and real-world applicability. For validation, we used the real (open source) Libra dataset and the recently released synthetic datasets by IBM Watson. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/mhaseebtariq/redirect.

AI.tldr: 提出ReDiRect框架，通过无监督方法将大型交易图模糊分区为可管理组件，以高效检测洗钱活动，减少误报并提高实际应用性。
AI.motivation: 现有洗钱检测方法存在局限性：洗钱者通过模仿交易模式逃避监控，现有算法难以处理大规模复杂数据，基于风险规则的刚性系统产生过多误报信号。
AI.method: 提出ReDiRect框架（REduce, DIstribute, and RECTify），采用无监督方法将大型交易图模糊分区为更小、可管理的组件，实现分布式快速处理，并定义改进的评估指标来更好捕捉洗钱模式。
AI.result: 在真实Libra数据集和IBM Watson合成数据集上的实验表明，该框架在效率和实际应用性方面优于现有和最先进技术，实现了卓越性能。
AI.conclusion: ReDiRect框架有效解决了洗钱检测中的规模、复杂性和误报问题，通过无监督图分区方法和改进评估指标，为实际金融监控提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: Cost-Efficient Estimation of General Abilities Across Benchmarks
summary: Thousands of diverse benchmarks have been developed to measure the quality of large language models (LLMs). Yet prior work has demonstrated that LLM performance is often sufficiently explained by a small set of latent factors, or abilities. This suggests the potential for more efficient and principled benchmarking, but it remains difficult to compare the quality of different methods. Motivated by predictive validity, we argue that the quality of a benchmarking framework should be grounded in how efficiently it enables the prediction of model performance on unseen tasks. To analyze this objective, we collect the "Wide-scale Item Level Dataset" (WILD), a dataset of item-model response pairs, comprising evaluations of 65 models on 109,564 unique items spanning 163 tasks drawn from 27 datasets. This dataset enables the first analysis of how different techniques can predict a model's performance on a large, diverse collection of unseen tasks under different budget constraints. We demonstrate that combining a modified multidimensional item response theory (IRT) model with adaptive item selection driven by optimal experimental design can predict performance on 112 held-out benchmark tasks with a mean absolute error (MAE) of less than 7%, and can do so after observing only 16 items. We further demonstrate that incorporating cost-aware discount factors into our selection criteria can reduce the total tokens needed to reach 7% MAE from 141,000 tokens to only 22,000, an 85% reduction in evaluation cost.

AI.tldr: 提出基于预测效度的基准测试质量评估框架，通过WILD数据集分析不同技术在预算约束下预测模型在未见任务上性能的能力，展示改进的多维IRT模型结合自适应项目选择能高效预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有大量基准测试评估大语言模型，但研究表明模型性能可由少数潜在能力因子解释，这为更高效、原则化的基准测试提供了可能，但缺乏比较不同方法质量的统一框架。
AI.method: 收集WIDE-scale Item Level Dataset (WILD)，包含65个模型在163个任务上的109,564个独特项目响应对；提出基于预测效度的评估框架，结合改进的多维IRT模型和最优实验设计驱动的自适应项目选择，并引入成本感知折扣因子。
AI.result: 改进的多维IRT模型结合自适应项目选择能在仅观察16个项目后，以小于7%的平均绝对误差预测112个保留基准任务性能；加入成本感知折扣因子可将达到7%MAE所需总token从141,000减少到22,000，降低85%评估成本。
AI.conclusion: 基于预测效度的基准测试评估框架结合多维IRT和自适应项目选择能显著提高评估效率，大幅降低评估成本，为更高效、原则化的模型基准测试提供了可行方案。

title: Regularizing Attention Scores with Bootstrapping
summary:
Vision transformers (ViT) rely on attention mechanism to weigh input features, and therefore attention scores have naturally been considered as explanations for its decision-making process. However, attention scores are almost always non-zero, resulting in noisy and diffused attention maps and limiting interpretability. Can we quantify uncertainty measures of attention scores and obtain regularized attention scores? To this end, we consider attention scores of ViT in a statistical framework where independent noise would lead to insignificant yet non-zero scores. Leveraging statistical learning techniques, we introduce the bootstrapping for attention scores which generates a baseline distribution of attention scores by resampling input features. Such a bootstrap distribution is then used to estimate significances and posterior probabilities of attention scores. In natural and medical images, the proposed \emph{Attention Regularization} approach demonstrates a straightforward removal of spurious attention arising from noise, drastically improving shrinkage and sparsity. Quantitative evaluations are conducted using both simulation and real-world datasets. Our study highlights bootstrapping as a practical regularization tool when using attention scores as explanations for ViT.
  Code available: https://github.com/ncchung/AttentionRegularization

AI.tldr: 提出基于自助法的注意力正则化方法，通过重采样输入特征生成注意力分数的基线分布，估计显著性并去除噪声引起的虚假注意力，提高ViT注意力图的稀疏性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformers的注意力分数通常非零，导致注意力图噪声大、扩散性强，限制了可解释性。需要量化注意力分数的不确定性并获取正则化的注意力分数。
AI.method: 将ViT注意力分数置于统计框架中，引入自助法（bootstrapping）通过重采样输入特征生成注意力分数的基线分布，利用该分布估计注意力分数的显著性和后验概率，实现注意力正则化。
AI.result: 在自然图像和医学图像上，该方法能有效去除噪声引起的虚假注意力，显著提高注意力图的收缩性和稀疏性。通过模拟和真实数据集进行了定量评估。
AI.conclusion: 自助法可作为实用的正则化工具，当使用注意力分数作为ViT解释时，能有效提高注意力图的解释性和可靠性。

title: Efficient and Principled Scientific Discovery through Bayesian Optimization: A Tutorial
summary: Traditional scientific discovery relies on an iterative hypothesise-experiment-refine cycle that has driven progress for centuries, but its intuitive, ad-hoc implementation often wastes resources, yields inefficient designs, and misses critical insights. This tutorial presents Bayesian Optimisation (BO), a principled probability-driven framework that formalises and automates this core scientific cycle. BO uses surrogate models (e.g., Gaussian processes) to model empirical observations as evolving hypotheses, and acquisition functions to guide experiment selection, balancing exploitation of known knowledge and exploration of uncharted domains to eliminate guesswork and manual trial-and-error. We first frame scientific discovery as an optimisation problem, then unpack BO's core components, end-to-end workflows, and real-world efficacy via case studies in catalysis, materials science, organic synthesis, and molecule discovery. We also cover critical technical extensions for scientific applications, including batched experimentation, heteroscedasticity, contextual optimisation, and human-in-the-loop integration. Tailored for a broad audience, this tutorial bridges AI advances in BO with practical natural science applications, offering tiered content to empower cross-disciplinary researchers to design more efficient experiments and accelerate principled scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本教程介绍贝叶斯优化(BO)作为科学发现的概率驱动框架，通过替代模型和采集函数自动化假设-实验-优化循环，应用于催化、材料科学等领域。
AI.motivation: 传统科学发现依赖直觉的假设-实验-优化循环，存在资源浪费、设计低效和关键洞察缺失的问题。需要一种原则性的概率驱动框架来形式化和自动化这一核心科学循环。
AI.method: 贝叶斯优化使用替代模型（如高斯过程）将经验观察建模为演化假设，利用采集函数指导实验选择，平衡已知知识的利用和未知领域的探索。教程涵盖BO的核心组件、端到端工作流程，以及针对科学应用的技术扩展。
AI.result: 通过催化、材料科学、有机合成和分子发现等案例研究展示了BO在现实世界中的有效性。教程提供了分层内容，使跨学科研究人员能够设计更高效的实验。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯优化为科学发现提供了一个原则性的概率驱动框架，能够消除猜测和手动试错，加速原则性科学发现，并桥接AI进展与自然科学实际应用。

title: The power of context: Random Forest classification of near synonyms. A case study in Modern Hindi
summary:
Synonymy is a widespread yet puzzling linguistic phenomenon. Absolute synonyms theoretically should not exist, as they do not expand language's expressive potential. However, it was suggested that even if synonyms denote the same concept, they may reflect different perspectives or carry distinct cultural associations, claims that have rarely been tested quantitatively.
  In Hindi, prolonged contact with Persian produced many Perso-Arabic loanwords coexisting with their Sanskrit counterpart, forming numerous synonym pairs. This study investigates whether centuries after these borrowings appeared in the Subcontinent their origin can still be distinguished using distributional data alone and regardless of their semantic content.
  A Random Forest trained on word embeddings of Hindi synonyms successfully classified words by Sanskrit or Perso-Arabic origin, even when they were semantically unrelated, suggesting that usage patterns preserve traces of etymology. These findings provide quantitative evidence that context encodes etymological signals and that synonymy may reflect subtle but systematic distinctions linked to origin. They support the idea that synonymous words can offer different perspectives and that etymologically related words may form distinct conceptual subspaces, creating a new type of semantic frame shaped by historical origin. Overall, the results highlight the power of context in capturing nuanced distinctions beyond traditional semantic similarity.

AI.tldr: 使用词嵌入和随机森林模型，仅基于分布数据就能区分印地语中梵语和波斯-阿拉伯语源同义词，表明使用模式保留了词源信号，同义词反映了与起源相关的系统差异。
AI.motivation: 研究同义词现象，特别是绝对同义词理论上不应存在，因为它们不扩展语言表达能力。但即使同义词表示相同概念，它们可能反映不同视角或携带不同文化关联，这些主张很少被定量测试。印地语中梵语和波斯-阿拉伯语源词共存形成众多同义词对，为研究提供了理想案例。
AI.method: 使用基于分布数据的词嵌入技术，训练随机森林分类器来区分印地语中梵语和波斯-阿拉伯语源的同义词。该方法不依赖语义内容，仅基于词语在上下文中的使用模式。
AI.result: 随机森林模型成功分类了梵语和波斯-阿拉伯语源的词语，即使这些词语在语义上无关。这表明使用模式保留了词源痕迹，上下文编码了词源信号。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了定量证据，表明上下文编码词源信号，同义词可能反映与起源相关的微妙但系统性的区别。同义词可以提供不同视角，词源相关的词语可能形成不同的概念子空间，创造由历史起源塑造的新型语义框架。结果突显了上下文在捕捉超越传统语义相似性的细微区别方面的能力。

title: Perceptual misalignment of texture representations in convolutional neural networks
summary: Mathematical modeling of visual textures traces back to Julesz's intuition that texture perception in humans is based on local correlations between image features. An influential approach for texture analysis and generation generalizes this notion to linear correlations between the nonlinear features computed by convolutional neural networks (CNNs), compiled into Gram matrices. Given that CNNs are often used as models for the visual system, it is natural to ask whether such "texture representations" spontaneously align with the textures' perceptual content, and in particular whether those CNNs that are regarded as better models for the visual system also possess more human-like texture representations. Here we compare the perceptual content captured by feature correlations computed for a diverse pool of CNNs, and we compare it to the models' perceptual alignment with the mammalian visual system as measured by Brain-Score. Surprisingly, we find that there is no connection between conventional measures of CNN quality as a model of the visual system and its alignment with human texture perception. We conclude that texture perception involves mechanisms that are distinct from those that are commonly modeled using approaches based on CNNs trained on object recognition, possibly depending on the integration of contextual information.

AI.tldr: 研究发现CNN作为视觉系统模型的质量与其纹理感知对齐度无关，表明纹理感知机制不同于基于物体识别训练的CNN常用建模方法
AI.motivation: 探究CNN特征相关性（Gram矩阵）是否自发对齐于纹理的感知内容，以及被视为更好视觉系统模型的CNN是否拥有更接近人类的纹理表示
AI.method: 比较多样化CNN池中特征相关性捕获的感知内容，并将其与Brain-Score测量的模型与哺乳动物视觉系统的感知对齐度进行对比
AI.result: 令人惊讶地发现，CNN作为视觉系统模型的常规质量度量与其与人类纹理感知的对齐度之间没有关联
AI.conclusion: 纹理感知涉及与基于物体识别训练的CNN常用建模方法不同的机制，可能依赖于上下文信息的整合

title: Model Merging via Data-Free Covariance Estimation
summary: Model merging provides a way of cheaply combining individual models to produce a model that inherits each individual's capabilities. While some merging methods can approach the performance of multitask training, they are often heuristically motivated and lack theoretical justification. A principled alternative is to pose model merging as a layer-wise optimization problem that directly minimizes interference between tasks. However, this formulation requires estimating per-layer covariance matrices from data, which may not be available when performing merging. In contrast, many of the heuristically-motivated methods do not require auxiliary data, making them practically advantageous. In this work, we revisit the interference minimization framework and show that, under certain conditions, covariance matrices can be estimated directly from difference matrices, eliminating the need for data while also reducing computational costs. We validate our approach across vision and language benchmarks on models ranging from 86M parameters to 7B parameters, outperforming previous data-free state-of-the-art merging methods

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需数据的模型合并方法，通过从差异矩阵直接估计协方差矩阵，消除对辅助数据的需求，同时降低计算成本
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法存在两个问题：1）启发式方法缺乏理论依据；2）基于干扰最小化的优化方法需要数据来估计协方差矩阵，而数据在实际合并时可能不可得。本文旨在开发一种既具有理论依据又无需数据的模型合并方法
AI.method: 重新审视干扰最小化框架，发现在特定条件下，可以直接从模型差异矩阵估计协方差矩阵，从而消除对数据的需求。该方法将模型合并表述为逐层优化问题，直接最小化任务间的干扰
AI.result: 在视觉和语言基准测试上验证了该方法，模型规模从8600万参数到70亿参数不等，性能优于先前最先进的无数据合并方法
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种理论上有依据且无需数据的模型合并方法，通过从差异矩阵直接估计协方差矩阵，既保持了理论优势又具有实际可行性，在多种基准测试中表现出色

title: Are Finer Citations Always Better? Rethinking Granularity for Attributed Generation
summary: Citation granularity - whether to cite individual sentences, paragraphs, or documents - is a critical design choice in attributed generation. While fine-grained citations are often preferred for precise human verification, their impact on model performance remains under-explored. We analyze four model scales (8B-120B) and demonstrate that enforcing fine-grained citations degrades attribution quality by 16-276% compared to the best-performing granularity. We observe a consistent performance pattern where attribution quality peaks at intermediate granularities (paragraph-level). Our analysis suggests that fine-grained (sentence-level) citations disrupt necessary semantic dependencies for attributing evidence to answer claims, while excessively coarse citations (multi-paragraph) introduce distracting noise. Importantly, the magnitude of this performance gap varies non-monotonically with model scale: fine-grained constraints disproportionately penalize larger models, suggesting that atomic citation units disrupt the multi-sentence information synthesis at which these models excel. Strikingly, citation-optimal granularity leads to substantial gains in attribution quality while preserving or even improving answer correctness. Overall, our findings demonstrate that optimizing solely for human verification via fine-grained citation disregards model constraints, compromising both attribution faithfulness and generation reliability. Instead, effective attribution requires aligning citation granularity with the model's natural semantic scope.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在属性生成中，引用粒度（句子级、段落级或文档级）对模型性能有显著影响，精细粒度引用会降低属性质量16-276%，而段落级引用效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索引用粒度（句子级、段落级或文档级）对属性生成模型性能的影响。虽然精细粒度引用通常被认为便于人类验证，但其对模型性能的具体影响尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 方法包括分析四个不同规模的模型（8B-120B），比较不同引用粒度（句子级、段落级、文档级）对属性质量和答案正确性的影响，并研究模型规模与最优引用粒度之间的关系。
AI.result: 结果显示：1) 强制精细粒度引用使属性质量下降16-276%；2) 属性质量在中间粒度（段落级）达到峰值；3) 精细粒度引用会破坏证据与答案之间的语义依赖关系；4) 过粗的引用引入干扰噪声；5) 性能差距随模型规模非单调变化，精细粒度约束对大型模型影响更大；6) 最优引用粒度在提升属性质量的同时保持甚至改善答案正确性。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：仅为了便于人类验证而优化精细粒度引用忽视了模型约束，会损害属性忠实性和生成可靠性。有效的属性生成需要将引用粒度与模型的自然语义范围对齐，段落级引用通常是最佳选择。

title: SECURE: Stable Early Collision Understanding via Robust Embeddings in Autonomous Driving
summary: While deep learning has significantly advanced accident anticipation, the robustness of these safety-critical systems against real-world perturbations remains a major challenge. We reveal that state-of-the-art models like CRASH, despite their high performance, exhibit significant instability in predictions and latent representations when faced with minor input perturbations, posing serious reliability risks. To address this, we introduce SECURE - Stable Early Collision Understanding Robust Embeddings, a framework that formally defines and enforces model robustness. SECURE is founded on four key attributes: consistency and stability in both prediction space and latent feature space. We propose a principled training methodology that fine-tunes a baseline model using a multi-objective loss, which minimizes divergence from a reference model and penalizes sensitivity to adversarial perturbations. Experiments on DAD and CCD datasets demonstrate that our approach not only significantly enhances robustness against various perturbations but also improves performance on clean data, achieving new state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: SECURE框架通过定义和执行模型鲁棒性，解决了事故预测模型对微小输入扰动敏感的问题，在保持清洁数据性能的同时显著提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习在事故预测方面取得显著进展，但这些安全关键系统在真实世界扰动下的鲁棒性仍然是一个重大挑战。研究发现即使像CRASH这样的最先进模型，在面对微小输入扰动时也会表现出预测和潜在表示的不稳定性，这带来了严重的可靠性风险。
AI.method: 提出SECURE框架，基于四个关键属性：预测空间和潜在特征空间的一致性和稳定性。采用原则性训练方法，通过多目标损失函数对基线模型进行微调，该损失函数最小化与参考模型的差异，并惩罚对对抗性扰动的敏感性。
AI.result: 在DAD和CCD数据集上的实验表明，该方法不仅显著增强了对各种扰动的鲁棒性，还提高了在清洁数据上的性能，取得了新的最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: SECURE框架通过形式化定义和执行模型鲁棒性，有效解决了事故预测模型对输入扰动的敏感性问题，为安全关键系统提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Wired for Overconfidence: A Mechanistic Perspective on Inflated Verbalized Confidence in LLMs
summary: Large language models are often not just wrong, but \emph{confidently wrong}: when they produce factually incorrect answers, they tend to verbalize overly high confidence rather than signal uncertainty. Such verbalized overconfidence can mislead users and weaken confidence scores as a reliable uncertainty signal, yet its internal mechanisms remain poorly understood. We present a circuit-level mechanistic analysis of this inflated verbalized confidence in LLMs, organized around three axes: capturing verbalized confidence as a differentiable internal signal, identifying the circuits that causally inflate it, and leveraging these insights for targeted inference-time recalibration. Across two instruction-tuned LLMs on three datasets, we find that a compact set of MLP blocks and attention heads, concentrated in middle-to-late layers, consistently writes the confidence-inflation signal at the final token position. We further show that targeted inference-time interventions on these circuits substantially improve calibration. Together, our results suggest that verbalized overconfidence in LLMs is driven by identifiable internal circuits and can be mitigated through targeted intervention.

AI.tldr: 论文对LLM中过度自信的言语表达进行电路级机制分析，发现特定MLP块和注意力头在中间到后期层中写入过度自信信号，并通过针对性干预改善校准
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型经常不仅给出错误答案，而且"过度自信地错误"：当产生事实不正确的答案时，它们倾向于表达过高的置信度而不是表示不确定性。这种言语化的过度自信会误导用户并削弱置信分数作为可靠不确定性信号的作用，但其内部机制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 提出围绕三个轴心的电路级机制分析：1) 将言语化置信度捕获为可微分的内部信号；2) 识别因果性夸大该信号的电路；3) 利用这些见解进行针对性推理时重新校准。在两个指令调优的LLM和三个数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 发现一组紧凑的MLP块和注意力头（集中在中间到后期层）持续在最终标记位置写入置信度夸大信号。进一步表明对这些电路的针对性推理时干预显著改善了校准。
AI.conclusion: LLM中的言语化过度自信由可识别的内部电路驱动，可以通过针对性干预来缓解。这为理解和改善LLM的校准提供了机制性见解。

title: AffordTissue: Dense Affordance Prediction for Tool-Action Specific Tissue Interaction
summary: Surgical action automation has progressed rapidly toward achieving surgeon-like dexterous control, driven primarily by advances in learning from demonstration and vision-language-action models. While these have demonstrated success in table-top experiments, translating them to clinical deployment remains challenging: current methods offer limited predictability on where instruments will interact on tissue surfaces and lack explicit conditioning inputs to enforce tool-action-specific safe interaction regions. Addressing this gap, we introduce AffordTissue, a multimodal framework for predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions as dense heatmaps during cholecystectomy. Our approach combines a temporal vision encoder capturing tool motion and tissue dynamics across multiple viewpoints, language conditioning enabling generalization across diverse instrument-action pairs, and a DiT-style decoder for dense affordance prediction. We establish the first tissue affordance benchmark by curating and annotating 15,638 video clips across 103 cholecystectomy procedures, covering six unique tool-action pairs involving four instruments (hook, grasper, scissors, clipper) and their associated tasks: dissection, grasping, clipping, and cutting. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvement over vision-language model baselines (20.6 px ASSD vs. 60.2 px for Molmo-VLM), showing that our task-specific architecture outperforms large-scale foundation models for dense surgical affordance prediction. By predicting tool-action specific tissue affordance regions, AffordTissue provides explicit spatial reasoning for safe surgical automation, potentially unlocking explicit policy guidance toward appropriate tissue regions and early safe stop when instruments deviate outside predicted safe zones.

AI.tldr: AffordTissue：用于胆囊切除术中预测工具-动作特定组织可操作性区域的密集热图预测框架，通过多模态架构显著提升手术自动化安全性
AI.motivation: 当前手术动作自动化方法在临床部署中存在局限性：缺乏对器械在组织表面交互位置的预测能力，缺少强制执行工具-动作特定安全交互区域的显式条件输入，这阻碍了手术自动化向临床应用的转化
AI.method: 提出AffordTissue多模态框架，结合：1）时序视觉编码器捕捉多视角下的工具运动和组织动态；2）语言条件化实现不同器械-动作对的泛化；3）DiT风格解码器进行密集可操作性预测。建立了首个组织可操作性基准数据集，包含103个胆囊切除术的15,638个视频片段，涵盖4种器械（钩、抓钳、剪刀、夹钳）和6种工具-动作对
AI.result: 实验显示显著优于视觉语言模型基线（20.6像素ASSD vs. 60.2像素的Molmo-VLM），任务特定架构在大规模基础模型上表现出色，为密集手术可操作性预测提供了更好的性能
AI.conclusion: AffordTissue通过预测工具-动作特定组织可操作性区域，为安全手术自动化提供了显式空间推理，可能实现向适当组织区域的显式策略指导，并在器械偏离预测安全区域时实现早期安全停止

title: Massively Parallel Exact Inference for Hawkes Processes
summary: Multivariate Hawkes processes are a widely used class of self-exciting point processes, but maximum likelihood estimation naively scales as $O(N^2)$ in the number of events. The canonical linear exponential Hawkes process admits a faster $O(N)$ recurrence, but prior work evaluates this recurrence sequentially, without exploiting parallelization on modern GPUs. We show that the Hawkes process intensity can be expressed as a product of sparse transition matrices admitting a linear-time associative multiply, enabling computation via a parallel prefix scan. This yields a simple yet massively parallelizable algorithm for maximum likelihood estimation of linear exponential Hawkes processes. Our method reduces the computational complexity to approximately $O(N/P)$ with $P$ parallel processors, and naturally yields a batching scheme to maintain constant memory usage, avoiding GPU memory constraints. Importantly, it computes the exact likelihood without any additional assumptions or approximations, preserving the simplicity and interpretability of the model. We demonstrate orders-of-magnitude speedups on simulated and real datasets, scaling to thousands of nodes and tens of millions of events, substantially beyond scales reported in prior work. We provide an open-source PyTorch library implementing our optimizations.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于线性指数Hawkes过程最大似然估计的并行前缀扫描算法，将计算复杂度从O(N²)降低到O(N/P)，实现了大规模并行化。
AI.motivation: 多元Hawkes过程的最大似然估计计算复杂度为O(N²)，现有线性指数Hawkes过程的O(N)递归算法无法充分利用现代GPU的并行计算能力。
AI.method: 将Hawkes过程强度表示为稀疏转移矩阵的乘积，通过线性时间关联乘法实现并行前缀扫描计算，支持大规模并行处理。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实数据集上实现了数量级的加速，可扩展到数千个节点和数千万个事件，远超先前工作的规模。
AI.conclusion: 提出的并行前缀扫描算法为线性指数Hawkes过程提供了精确、高效且可扩展的最大似然估计方法，保持了模型的简单性和可解释性。

title: GRAZE: Grounded Refinement and Motion-Aware Zero-Shot Event Localization
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted to the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision in Sports (CVSports) code: https://github.com/AhsanZaidi12/GRAZE
summary: American football practice generates video at scale, yet the interaction of interest occupies only a brief window of each long, untrimmed clip. Reliable biomechanical analysis, therefore, depends on spatiotemporal localization that identifies both the interacting entities and the onset of contact. We study First Point of Contact (FPOC), defined as the first frame in which a player physically touches a tackle dummy, in unconstrained practice footage with camera motion, clutter, multiple similarly equipped athletes, and rapid pose changes around impact. We present GRAZE, a training-free pipeline for FPOC localization that requires no labeled tackle-contact examples. GRAZE uses Grounding DINO to discover candidate player-dummy interactions, refines them with motion-aware temporal reasoning, and uses SAM2 as an explicit pixel-level verifier of contact rather than relying on detection confidence alone. This separation between candidate discovery and contact confirmation makes the approach robust to cluttered scenes and unstable grounding near impact. On 738 tackle-practice videos, GRAZE produces valid outputs for 97.4% of clips and localizes FPOC within $\pm$ 10 frames on 77.5% of all clips and within $\pm$ 20 frames on 82.7% of all clips. These results show that frame-accurate contact onset localization in real-world practice footage is feasible without task-specific training.

AI.tldr: GRAZE：一种无需训练、无需标注接触示例的框架，用于在美式足球训练视频中定位首次接触点（FPOC），通过目标检测、运动感知时序推理和像素级接触验证实现鲁棒定位。
AI.motivation: 美式足球训练产生大量视频，但关键交互（接触）只占长视频中的短暂窗口。可靠的生物力学分析需要时空定位来识别交互实体和接触起始点。现有方法面临相机运动、杂乱场景、多个相似装备运动员以及冲击时快速姿态变化等挑战。
AI.method: GRAZE采用训练免费的三阶段流水线：1) 使用Grounding DINO发现候选球员-假人交互；2) 通过运动感知时序推理进行细化；3) 使用SAM2作为显式像素级接触验证器，而非仅依赖检测置信度。候选发现与接触确认的分离使方法对杂乱场景和冲击附近不稳定的目标检测具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在738个擒抱训练视频上，GRAZE在97.4%的视频中产生有效输出，在77.5%的视频中将FPOC定位在±10帧内，在82.7%的视频中定位在±20帧内。这表明无需任务特定训练即可在真实训练视频中实现帧级准确的接触起始定位。
AI.conclusion: GRAZE证明了在无约束训练视频中实现帧级准确接触起始定位的可行性，无需任务特定训练或标注接触示例。该方法通过分离候选发现和接触确认，对杂乱场景和冲击附近不稳定的目标检测具有鲁棒性，为生物力学分析提供了实用解决方案。

title: Malliavin Calculus for Counterfactual Gradient Estimation in Adaptive Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers the loss function of a forward learner from its observed responses adaptive IRL aims to reconstruct the loss function of a forward learner by passively observing its gradients as it performs reinforcement learning (RL). This paper proposes a novel passive Langevin-based algorithm that achieves adaptive IRL. The key difficulty in adaptive IRL is that the required gradients in the passive algorithm are counterfactual, that is, they are conditioned on events of probability zero under the forward learner's trajectory. Therefore, naive Monte Carlo estimators are prohibitively inefficient, and kernel smoothing, though common, suffers from slow convergence. We overcome this by employing Malliavin calculus to efficiently estimate the required counterfactual gradients. We reformulate the counterfactual conditioning as a ratio of unconditioned expectations involving Malliavin quantities, thus recovering standard estimation rates. We derive the necessary Malliavin derivatives and their adjoint Skorohod integral formulations for a general Langevin structure, and provide a concrete algorithmic approach which exploits these for counterfactual gradient estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Malliavin微积分的被动Langevin算法，用于自适应逆强化学习，通过有效估计反事实梯度来克服传统方法的低效问题
AI.motivation: 自适应逆强化学习需要从观察到的梯度中恢复前向学习者的损失函数，但所需的反事实梯度条件概率为零，传统蒙特卡洛估计器效率低下，核平滑方法收敛缓慢
AI.method: 提出被动Langevin算法，利用Malliavin微积分将反事实条件转化为无条件期望的比值，推导Malliavin导数及其伴随Skorohod积分形式，提供具体算法实现反事实梯度估计
AI.result: 通过Malliavin微积分方法能够有效估计反事实梯度，恢复标准估计速率，克服传统方法的效率问题
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于Malliavin微积分的被动Langevin算法为自适应逆强化学习提供了有效的反事实梯度估计方法，解决了传统方法在效率和收敛速度方面的局限性

title: Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin: LLM Output Diversity is Everything, Everywhere, All at Once
summary: Research on Large Language Models (LLMs) studies output variation across generation, reasoning, alignment, and representational analysis, often under the umbrella of "diversity." Yet the terminology remains fragmented, largely because the normative objectives underlying tasks are rarely made explicit. We introduce the Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin framework, which models output variation along a homogeneity-heterogeneity axis, where valuation is determined by the task and its normative objective. We organize tasks into four normative contexts: epistemic (factuality), interactional (user utility), societal (representation), and safety (robustness). For each, we examine the failure modes and vocabulary such as hallucination, mode collapse, bias, and erasure through which variation is studied. We apply the framework to analyze all pairwise cross-contextual interactions, revealing that optimizing for one objective, such as improving safety, can inadvertently harm demographic representation or creative diversity. We argue for context-aware evaluation of output variation, reframing it as a property shaped by task objectives rather than a model's intrinsic trait.

AI.tldr: 提出Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin框架，将大语言模型输出变化建模为同质-异质轴，根据任务规范目标进行价值评估，分析四个规范上下文及其交互影响
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型研究中关于输出变化的术语碎片化，缺乏明确的任务规范目标，需要统一的框架来理解不同任务背景下输出变化的价值和意义
AI.method: 引入Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin框架，将输出变化建模为同质-异质连续体，基于任务规范目标进行价值评估。将任务组织为四个规范上下文：认知性（事实性）、交互性（用户效用）、社会性（代表性）、安全性（鲁棒性）。分析每个上下文的失败模式和词汇，并应用框架分析所有成对跨上下文交互
AI.result: 框架揭示了优化一个目标（如安全性）可能无意中损害人口统计代表性或创造性多样性。输出变化应被视为由任务目标塑造的属性，而非模型的固有特征
AI.conclusion: 需要基于上下文感知的输出变化评估，将其重新定义为由任务目标塑造的属性，而非模型的固有特征，以解决不同规范目标之间的潜在冲突

title: LESV: Language Embedded Sparse Voxel Fusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
summary: Recent advancements in open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding heavily rely on 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to register vision-language features into 3D space. However, we identify two critical limitations in these approaches: the spatial ambiguity arising from unstructured, overlapping Gaussians which necessitates probabilistic feature registration, and the multi-level semantic ambiguity caused by pooling features over object-level masks, which dilutes fine-grained details. To address these challenges, we present a novel framework that leverages Sparse Voxel Rasterization (SVRaster) as a structured, disjoint geometry representation. By regularizing SVRaster with monocular depth and normal priors, we establish a stable geometric foundation. This enables a deterministic, confidence-aware feature registration process and suppresses the semantic bleeding artifact common in 3DGS. Furthermore, we resolve multi-level ambiguity by exploiting the emerging dense alignment properties of foundation model AM-RADIO, avoiding the computational overhead of hierarchical training methods. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on Open Vocabulary 3D Object Retrieval and Point Cloud Understanding benchmarks, particularly excelling on fine-grained queries where registration methods typically fail.

AI.tldr: 提出基于稀疏体素光栅化的结构化几何表示方法，解决3D高斯泼溅在开放词汇3D场景理解中的空间模糊性和多级语义模糊性问题，实现确定性特征注册并提升细粒度查询性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的开放词汇3D场景理解方法存在两个关键限制：1) 非结构化重叠高斯分布导致的空间模糊性，需要概率特征注册；2) 基于物体级掩码的特征池化导致的多级语义模糊性，稀释了细粒度细节。
AI.method: 提出基于稀疏体素光栅化的结构化、不相交几何表示框架，通过单目深度和法线先验进行正则化，建立稳定几何基础。实现确定性、置信感知的特征注册过程，并利用基础模型AM-RADIO的密集对齐特性解决多级模糊性，避免分层训练的计算开销。
AI.result: 在开放词汇3D物体检索和点云理解基准测试中达到最先进性能，特别是在特征注册方法通常失败的细粒度查询任务上表现优异，有效抑制了3DGS中常见的语义渗漏伪影。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏体素光栅化作为结构化几何表示优于非结构化3D高斯泼溅，能够提供确定性特征注册并解决多级语义模糊性，为开放词汇3D场景理解提供了更稳定、精确的解决方案。

title: Why Instruction-Based Unlearning Fails in Diffusion Models?
summary: Instruction-based unlearning has proven effective for modifying the behavior of large language models at inference time, but whether this paradigm extends to other generative models remains unclear. In this work, we investigate instruction-based unlearning in diffusion-based image generation models and show, through controlled experiments across multiple concepts and prompt variants, that diffusion models systematically fail to suppress targeted concepts when guided solely by natural-language unlearning instructions. By analyzing both the CLIP text encoder and cross-attention dynamics during the denoising process, we find that unlearning instructions do not induce sustained reductions in attention to the targeted concept tokens, causing the targeted concept representations to persist throughout generation. These results reveal a fundamental limitation of prompt-level instruction in diffusion models and suggest that effective unlearning requires interventions beyond inference-time language control.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型无法通过自然语言指令有效遗忘特定概念，指令遗忘在图像生成模型中存在根本性限制
AI.motivation: 探究指令遗忘范式是否适用于扩散模型等非语言生成模型，验证自然语言指令在图像生成中的遗忘效果
AI.method: 通过多概念多提示变体的控制实验，分析CLIP文本编码器和去噪过程中的交叉注意力动态
AI.result: 扩散模型无法通过自然语言遗忘指令有效抑制目标概念，目标概念表示在生成过程中持续存在
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的指令遗忘存在根本性限制，有效遗忘需要超越推理时语言控制的干预措施

title: EgoFlow: Gradient-Guided Flow Matching for Egocentric 6DoF Object Motion Generation
summary: Understanding and predicting object motion from egocentric video is fundamental to embodied perception and interaction. However, generating physically consistent 6DoF trajectories remains challenging due to occlusions, fast motion, and the lack of explicit physical reasoning in existing generative models. We present EgoFlow, a flow-matching framework that synthesizes realistic and physically plausible trajectories conditioned on multimodal egocentric observations. EgoFlow employs a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver architecture to jointly model temporal dynamics, scene geometry, and semantic intent, while a gradient-guided inference process enforces differentiable physical constraints such as collision avoidance and motion smoothness. This combination yields coherent and controllable motion generation without post-hoc filtering or additional supervision. Experiments on real-world datasets HD-EPIC, EgoExo4D, and HOT3D show that EgoFlow outperforms diffusion-based and transformer baselines in accuracy, generalization, and physical realism, reducing collision rates by up to 79%, and strong generalization to unseen scenes. Our results highlight the promise of flow-based generative modeling for scalable and physically grounded egocentric motion understanding.

AI.tldr: EgoFlow：基于流匹配的框架，从多模态第一人称视角观测生成物理一致的6DoF物体轨迹，通过混合Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver架构和梯度引导推理实现物理约束，在多个真实数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 从第一人称视角视频理解和预测物体运动对具身感知和交互至关重要。现有生成模型缺乏显式物理推理，难以生成物理一致的6DoF轨迹，面临遮挡、快速运动和物理合理性等挑战。
AI.method: 提出EgoFlow流匹配框架，采用混合Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver架构联合建模时间动态、场景几何和语义意图。通过梯度引导推理过程强制执行可微物理约束（如碰撞避免和运动平滑性），无需后处理滤波或额外监督。
AI.result: 在HD-EPIC、EgoExo4D和HOT3D等真实数据集上，EgoFlow在准确性、泛化性和物理真实性方面优于基于扩散和Transformer的基线方法，碰撞率降低高达79%，对未见场景具有强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EgoFlow展示了基于流的生成模型在可扩展和物理基础的第一人称运动理解方面的潜力，通过结合生成建模和可微物理约束，实现了连贯可控的运动生成。

title: Residuals-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) has received increasing attention for learning policies from previously collected data without interaction with the real environment, which is particularly important in high-stakes applications. While a growing body of work has developed offline RL algorithms, these methods often rely on restrictive assumptions about data coverage and suffer from distribution shift. In this paper, we propose a residuals-based offline RL framework for general state and action spaces. Specifically, we define a residuals-based Bellman optimality operator that explicitly incorporates estimation error in learning transition dynamics into policy optimization by leveraging empirical residuals. We show that this Bellman operator is a contraction mapping and identify conditions under which its fixed point is asymptotically optimal and possesses finite-sample guarantees. We further develop a residuals-based offline deep Q-learning (DQN) algorithm. Using a stochastic CartPole environment, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our residuals-based offline DQN algorithm.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于残差的离线强化学习框架，通过显式地将转移动态估计误差纳入策略优化来解决分布偏移问题
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习在无需与环境交互的情况下从先前收集的数据中学习策略，这对于高风险应用尤为重要。现有方法通常依赖于数据覆盖的严格假设，且容易受到分布偏移的影响。
AI.method: 提出了基于残差的离线RL框架，定义了一个基于残差的贝尔曼最优算子，该算子通过利用经验残差将转移动态估计误差显式地纳入策略优化。进一步开发了基于残差的离线深度Q学习（DQN）算法。
AI.result: 证明了该贝尔曼算子是压缩映射，并确定了其固定点具有渐近最优性和有限样本保证的条件。在随机CartPole环境中验证了基于残差的离线DQN算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于残差的框架为一般状态和动作空间的离线强化学习提供了一种有效方法，能够处理分布偏移问题并具有理论保证。

title: Benchmark Problems and Benchmark Datasets for the evaluation of Machine and Deep Learning methods on Photoplethysmography signals: the D4 report from the QUMPHY project
summary: This report is part of the Qumphy project (22HLT01 Qumphy) that is funded by the European Union and is dedicated to the development of measures to quantify the uncertainties associated with Machine Learning algorithms applied to medical problems, in particular the analysis and processing of Photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. In this report, a list of six medical problems that are related to PPG signals and serve as Benchmark Problems is given. Suitable Benchmark datasets and their usage are described also.

AI.tldr: 该报告介绍了Qumphy项目中用于量化医疗机器学习算法不确定性的六个PPG相关基准问题及其数据集
AI.motivation: 开发量化机器学习算法在医疗应用中不确定性的方法，特别是在PPG信号分析领域，需要标准化的基准问题和数据集来评估算法性能
AI.method: 识别并定义了六个与PPG信号相关的医疗问题作为基准问题，同时描述了适用的基准数据集及其使用方法
AI.result: 建立了包含六个PPG相关医疗问题的基准问题集，并提供了相应的基准数据集描述和使用指南
AI.conclusion: 该报告为评估医疗机器学习算法在PPG信号分析中的不确定性提供了标准化的基准框架，有助于推动该领域的研究和算法比较

title: Countering Catastrophic Forgetting of Large Language Models for Better Instruction Following via Weight-Space Model Merging
summary: Large language models have been adopted in the medical domain for clinical documentation to reduce clinician burden. However, studies have reported that LLMs often "forget" a significant amount of instruction-following ability when fine-tuned using a task-specific medical dataset, a critical challenge in adopting general-purpose LLMs for clinical applications. This study presents a model merging framework to efficiently adapt general-purpose LLMs to the medical domain by countering this forgetting issue. By merging a clinical foundation model (GatorTronLlama) with a general instruct model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct) via interpolation-based merge methods, we seek to derive a domain-adapted model with strong performance on clinical tasks while retaining instruction-following ability. Comprehensive evaluation across medical benchmarks and five clinical generation tasks (e.g., radiology and discharge summarization) shows that merged models can effectively mitigate catastrophic forgetting, preserve clinical domain expertise, and retain instruction-following ability. In addition, our model merging strategies demonstrate training efficiency, achieving performance on par with fully fine-tuned baselines under severely constrained supervision (e.g., 64-shot vs. 256-shot). Consequently, weight-space merging constitutes a highly scalable solution for adapting open-source LLMs to clinical applications, facilitating broader deployment in resource-constrained healthcare environments.

AI.tldr: 提出模型合并框架，通过合并临床基础模型与通用指令模型，解决医学领域微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，在保持指令跟随能力的同时提升临床任务性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在医学领域应用时，使用特定医学数据集微调会导致严重的指令跟随能力遗忘，这是临床应用中采用通用LLMs的关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出模型合并框架，通过基于插值的合并方法将临床基础模型(GatorTronLlama)与通用指令模型(Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct)合并，获得领域适应模型。
